design.decision: Each extra bid trick adds 2 to the multiplier. A set multiplies the loss too, so every bid becomes a real wager.
design.opponent: Shown on the first scored round. Opponents defend harder against big contracts because a set now costs this team more.
design.rationale: This is the purest contract-scaled multiplier. It applies on sets as well, so it builds bid tension both ways, and it is higher-risk, bigger-reward than cb-contract-mult-made.
design.draftText: +2 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract

critic.concerns: Same signature as cc-mult-per-trick, differing only in amount; merge them and let the amount sweep decide.

history.note: draft-common: also proposed as cc-mult-per-trick with a different amount.
